title: Pork Kebab with Roasted Vegetables
description: A delicious and easy-to-make dish that combines the flavors of pork and roasted vegetables. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: mixed vegetables (bell peppers, zucchini, onions, cherry tomatoes)

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and paprika.
Add the pork cubes and mixed vegetables to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the pork and vegetables onto skewers.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the pork is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
